Linearizability: single objects, real-time order. Serializability: multi-object transactions in some serial order. Both together = strict serializability.

front: etcd default reads vs serializable reads?
back: Default reads are linearizable (leader confirms with a quorum). Serializable reads come from the local member and may be stale.

front: How to get an up-to-date ZooKeeper read?

front: The four session guarantees (Terry et al., 1994)?
back: Read-your-writes, monotonic reads, monotonic writes, writes-follow-reads.
